s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive, symmetric lower extremity weakness with urinary retention and cranial nerve involvement
salient_findings: Subacute, progressive, symmetric lower extremity weakness
Nodular thickening and enhancement of the lumbosacral nerve roots
key_facts: Normal MRI of brain and orbits
Abnormalities in MRI of lumbosacral spine
Nodular thickening and enhancement of lumbosacral nerve roots
Diffuse heterogeneous signal abnormalities in bone marrow
Cerebrospinal fluid with high white blood cell count
Cerebrospinal fluid with high red blood cell count

shortlist.label: Acute myeloid leukemia
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of violaceous cutaneous lesions (leukemia cutis) and atypical cells/blasts in cerebrospinal fluid

shortlist.label: Neurolymphomatosis
shortlist.why_kept: Progressive, symmetric lower extremity weakness, urinary retention, and cranial nerve involvement with abnormal cerebrospinal fluid findings

shortlist.label: POEMS syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Subacute progression of symptoms, severe flaccid quadriparesis, and diffuse heterogeneous signal abnormalities in bone marrow

shortlist.label: Plasma cell leukemia
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of diffuse heterogeneous signal abnormalities in bone marrow and abnormal cerebrospinal fluid findings

shortlist.label: Intravascular lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Progressive, symmetric lower extremity weakness, urinary retention, and cranial nerve involvement with abnormal cerebrospinal fluid findings

trace.fact: Subacute, progressive, symmetric lower extremity weakness

rule_in.why: it often presents with progressive symmetric weakness

rule_out.why: it typically presents with more systemic and acute symptoms

rule_in.why: it is associated with urinary retention

rule_out.why: it does not typically cause urinary retention

rule_in.why: it can cause cranial nerve involvement

rule_out.why: ptosis is not specific to any candidate

rule_in.why: it is known to cause violaceous cutaneous lesions

rule_out.why: lesions are not typical for this condition
